collection.description: Two friends challenge each other to carry baskets without spilling anything.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Two friends challenge each other to carry baskets without spilling anything. The spectators cheer for everyone approaching the finish.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two friends challenge each other to carry baskets without spilling anything. Someone starts too early and sheepishly returns to the line.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Two friends challenge each other to carry baskets without spilling anything. The winner is less interested in the prize than in catching their breath.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: Two friends challenge each other to carry baskets without spilling anything. Afterward, the competitors share water and compare stories.
